diagnosis: the adaptive breakaway in r12/r11b detected "no motion" from the teacher pose, but that pose is command odometry: the 40 ms pulses change the odometry every tick while the physical robot does not move, so the boost never fired. r10diag had recorded the exact stall signature: the visible alignment errors stayed at x=0.0135 m for many consecutive ticks.

r13_change.mode: search26_align_pulse (implementation updated; default off; same r12 profile)
r13_change.rule: issue the full-period breakaway pulse only when the visible error on the active axis has not changed by more than 1e-4 m for three consecutive ticks; otherwise keep the nominal 40 ms pulse.
